scope: Every published transaction of Square One Exhibit B account 1FR048: 1,050 observations, 1999-02-01 through 2008-12-03. Trustee computations in a complaint, not a complete BLMIS general ledger or a court finding. All twelve printed columns, zero-dollar observations, 709 starred withholding cells and source arithmetic discrepancies are retained. Under the exhibit's footnote [1], starred reported withholding amounts do not reduce principal. The principal and cash-counterpart accounts are a constructed principal-history book; they do not purport to reconstruct gross tax payments or dated IRS refunds. No source difference is silently corrected, tolerated or posted as a balancing adjustment.
star_interpretation: The literal star is preserved. A zero principal contribution is derived only under footnote [1], never parsed as a printed numeric zero.
